title: ConnectorManifest
description: Normative shape of a connector manifest, for connector/contracts/connector-manifest@1.0.0. A manifest is what makes a connector data rather than code: the tool set the agent is given, the approval classification of each operation, the compensating action undo replays and what an interrupted call meant are all read from here and from nowhere else (INV-CN-06). Validation is whole-manifest - a manifest that breaks any rule expressed here yields no tool at all, because a partially loaded connector would offer operations whose reversibility nobody declared. The rules this file cannot express are relations between members and are held by the contract document: that every tool names a capability this manifest declares, that no scope profile grants scope for a capability no tool requires, that snapshot.read_operation and compensation.tool name tools this manifest declares, that no two manifests share an id, and that an adapter is registered under the same id.

schema_version.description: The major.minor of the connector-manifest contract this manifest was written against, never the version of the connector. A manifest whose major number exceeds the build's is refused naming the application version it needs.

id.description: Identifies the connector for the lifetime of the product (INV-CN-04). Ledger records, approval rules and stored authorisations all refer to it, so changing it creates a different connector rather than a new version of this one.

version.description: Semantic version of this manifest's own content, independent of schema_version.

auth.description: How the platform is authorised. The server-side half of the same platform, where one is needed, is joined by provider_id.

capabilities.description: What a user enables and what a tool belongs to. Scopes are one consequence of a capability rather than its definition, which is why capabilities are declared here rather than inside the authorisation block.

scope_profiles.description: Profile to capability to scopes. Selecting a different profile changes what is requested of the user and nothing else; the profile in force is recorded with the authorisation it produced, so a later change of profile is a re-consent rather than a silent widening.

content_sanitization.description: Required of any connector that returns document, message or file content: fetched content is untrusted data, and this declares how it is neutralised before it reaches an agent's context.

name.description: The public tool name, carrying the connector id (INV-CN-05).

description.description: Shown to the model. Text only; it carries no capability of its own.

direction.description: A read tool carrying snapshot, compensation or irreversible is refused as a contradiction rather than silently reclassified.

capability.description: The one capability this tool belongs to; a key of capabilities.

reconciliation.description: Required on every tool, read or write. Its shape is job/contracts/tool-reconciliation@0.1.0, embedded here verbatim and not redefined; a declaration that is absent or unresolvable is treated as method "none", which routes an interrupted call to the user rather than to a repeat.

exclude_computed.description: The values the platform computes and refuses on write. Required, and may be empty: an empty array is the author stating that the platform computes none of this object's values, while an absent field is the author having not considered the question. The excluded values are stripped before the snapshot is recorded.

snapshot.description: Write tools only. How the prior state of the object being changed is read before the call, so that a compensating action can be built from it.

compensation.description: Write tools only, and exclusive with irreversible (INV-CN-07). Requires a snapshot, because a compensating action is built from recorded prior state.

irreversible.description: Write tools only, and exclusive with compensation. Declares that no operation of this platform reverses this one.

changes_permission.description: Read by the approval gate. Never read from a call's arguments.

bulk_threshold_param.description: The argument whose size makes a call bulk, for the gate's bulk classification.
